measurement: Checkpoint counts are an inventory, not equal-sized work units or a completion percentage. Unknown release coverage prevents an honest percent/ETA.
scope: Exact native 1.20.6 multiplayer behavior and explicitly enabled native experiments. Server generation/AI/loot stay authoritative; their client-visible results require acceptance. Singleplayer/Realms and optional extensions are separately visible.

lastRecordedValidation.note: Existing scoped checks at audited source; not a new exhaustive gameplay run.

1.20.3|Changes / Blocks / Grass|1.evidence: Native short_grass rename and tint dispatch checked against final target.

workflow: Update this JSON for each accepted batch, including evidence and acceptance criterion.
accepted means the named scope has native evidence and relevant regression/live checks; it never certifies a broader family.
missing requires inspected implementation evidence; unverified is not an assertion that code is absent.
Map release entries independently; server-owned results still need client acceptance where relevant.
Run node tools/port-1.20.6/parity-status.mjs --write, then --check; push validated batches.
Do not declare full parity until required checkpoints, release dispositions and native acceptance/build gates are closed.
